description: Keenable provides web search and clean-markdown page retrieval for AI agents. It lets agents search the web and fetch page content through hosted HTTP and MCP interfaces, with an optional account/API key for higher limits and usage tracking.
summary: Keenable exposes a REST API for web search/fetch (keyed and keyless public endpoints), a public streamable HTTP MCP server, and a `keenable` CLI.

surfaces.name: Keenable search and fetch API, keyless public endpoints
Keenable search and fetch API, keyless
